spec_coverage.note: Full pct depressed by orphaned Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (describes a different product)

findings.title: Traceability enforcer extracts false FR IDs from prose — false PASS/FAIL results
findings.detail: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ matches work item docIds (FR-0002..FR-0007) and spec cross-references (FR-070, FR-085) in prose, causing false FAILURE when running against Plans/dependency-linking. False positives obscure real gaps.
findings.recommendation: Constrain extraction to table column 1 only: r'^\|\s*(FR-[A-Za-z0-9-]+)\s*\|'

findings.title: Enforcer checks single plan only; dependency requirements never audited in default run
findings.detail: auto-select picks most recently modified requirements.md (all share same mtime → non-deterministic). FR-dependency-seed has zero Verifies refs but enforcer reports PASSED because it only scanned self-judging-workflow plan.
findings.recommendation: Add --all-plans flag iterating every Plans/*/requirements.md; use this in CI gate.

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed unimplemented — no source reference, no test
findings.detail: Implementation Delta explicitly flags FR-dependency-seed as Missing. Zero grep hits in Source/. Needs idempotent seed function calling addDependency for 4 documented work-item relationships.
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/store/seedData.ts; wire into app startup; add // Verifies: FR-dependency-seed.

findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md FR-001–FR-069 orphaned (different product)
findings.detail: 69 FRs describe a feature-request/bug/cycle SQLite platform. Current Source/ is a work-item workflow engine (in-memory store). Zero FRs are referenced in Source/. Inspector config points specs.dir to Specifications/ but enforcer ignores it.
findings.recommendation: Add deprecated status to dev-workflow-platform.md or archive it. Update inspector.config.yml specs.dir to Specifications/workflow-engine.md.

findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.' All three route files call store.* directly. Approve/reject/dispatch logic in workflow.ts mixes HTTP concerns with business logic.

findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files for same pages
findings.detail: Root-level and pages/ subdirectory both test the same components with overlapping but non-identical coverage. Risk of divergence; unclear which is canonical.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into tests/pages/; merge unique assertions from root-level files; delete duplicates.

findings.title: Silent .catch(() => ({})) in API client swallows JSON parse errors
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md: 'Never swallow errors silently.' The catch is intentional (non-JSON error bodies) but undocumented.
findings.recommendation: Add comment: // JSON may not be present on some error responses (e.g. 502 from proxy); fall back to empty object

findings.title: eslint-disable suppressing react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without rationale
findings.detail: Suppressing exhaustive-deps without documented reason can mask stale closure bugs.
findings.recommendation: Add rationale comment or restructure hook to satisfy the rule.

findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline NFRs have no enforcement or traceability
findings.detail: NFR-1 (E2E <5 min), NFR-2 (additive), NFR-3 (graceful degradation) exist in spec but are untraced in E2E configs.
findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: NFR-1/2/3 comments to playwright configs that implement these safeguards, or add timing assertions.
